summary: The proposed bounded, opt-in complete-tool-v1 design is sufficiently specified for human T3 review. No concrete material contradiction or blocking unspecified HOW was established against the frozen C1–C6 bar. This is document judgement, not implementation evidence.

criteria.rationale: Complete output has an explicit admissible JSON domain, canonical byte and structural limits, native envelope ownership, complete/unavailable/failure branches and no summary substitution. Every tool result remains required and retained; inability to capture or admit it stops the next model decision. TR01/TR02/TR04 require causal public-path evidence and rejecting controls.

The selected representation supplies the actual two-message request. Governance and data roles, immutable final snapshot, full-request limits/hash, paired upper-bound counter, output reservation and per-repair readmission are specified. Arbitrary data remains UNTRUSTED and cannot grant native authority. Missing qualification or inability to fit mandatory input prevents a model call. Synthetic count assumptions and the separate governed gateway route are expressly limited.

SUCCEEDED is not rewritten as body failure when output cannot be retained or admitted. Native journal/settlement, operation identity and provenance remain authoritative. Failed checkpoint persistence invokes durable reconciliation or an uncertain handoff, never automatic body replay to recover lost text. Completion cannot claim complete success from an unavailable envelope or UNKNOWN reservation; journal failure is not promoted into confirmed effect.

V1/V2 compatibility, mode binding, domain-separated logical digest and a reversible bounded base64 physical JSONB codec are explicit. Observation retention, prospective space checks and final-size checks are defined. Receipts persist before calls, settle once with idempotent repeated settlement, retain conservative charges under uncertainty, and reject late or conflicting results. All V2 checkpoint writes use a real CAS, conditional insert/update and post-commit receipt; memory and PostgreSQL contracts are distinguished. Mixed legacy writers and host rollout remain outside this isolated slice.

The design names owners, existing extension boundaries, limits, errors, persistence order, compatibility policies and a public-factory acceptance slice. TR01–TR09 include positive and rejecting controls across actual dispatch, selection, model request and stores; TR10 preserves the separate real differential obligation. SDK/worker/custom-port/default adoption and qualification obligations are recognized without claiming those consumers already support the proposal. The main HOW is in normative sections, rather than deferred to a future test.

Human T3 authority is required before BUILD. The proposal keeps prior independent approvals pending, limits local activation, retains the 36-card program and its original obligations, and makes no runtime, parity, provider, release or human-approval claim.

manualTraces.reasoning: Delivering A advances only a receipt cursor. A remains mandatory when B arrives; if the combined actual request does not fit, the model is not called. No eviction based on the cursor is permitted.

The effect stays natively settled. Further decision/dispatch stops. An unconfirmed checkpoint requires durable effect reconciliation; unavailable settlement/data leads to handoff or uncertainty and cannot authorize another body invocation.

Only a committed CAS receipt permits the call. An unresolved reservation on resume becomes UNKNOWN and retains its upper charge; another writer cannot use a conflicting CAS receipt. Settled duplicate receipts are no-op only for identical binding/digest/usage.

Logical JSON may contain U+0000, while the physical state stores only a fixed ASCII wrapper with canonical base64. Load restores strictly validated canonical UTF-8 JSON before the common logical digest/schema checks; the wrapper never becomes model input.

sourceInspection.method: Read source text only; never import or execute it. Current implementation is treated as CURRENT, not as implementing PROPOSED.
sourceInspection.readExtent: Full or necessary line ranges, exactly recorded in check-06 through check-09. All 24 packet files were read as bytes for integrity only; that does not imply semantic inspection of every source file.

boundaryEvidence.observation: Current digest/version validator and simple memory save establish the existing boundary that V2 codec/CAS must extend.
Current JSONB mapping and transaction-based save/load support the proposed adapter-local physical codec and transactional CAS changes; no claim those changes exist today.
Current summary-based prompt, rules-first path and internal repair loop identify where actual-request construction and per-attempt admission must change.
Current native operation key and bounded output capture identify the intended observation/dispatch boundary.
Public factory/profile routing and journal composition are real current integration boundaries.
Common message roles/limits do not make the entire harness ModelRequest a governed gateway request; the candidate expressly preserves that distinction.

authority.futureTests: TR01–TR10 NOT_RUN by design; their absence is not a document finding.

independence.mechanism: Single fresh assigned critic; no descendants/subagents; no model/effort change requested or made. Only the sealed packet was used as external task input; all working-directory and artifact writes were confined to review-r2. No earlier reviews/scores/findings, Lead evidence/checks, live repository content, historical links, external sites, application imports/execution, models/providers, PostgreSQL or native helpers were accessed.
independence.limits: Shared filesystem is not a security isolation boundary. Pre/post file membership and byte hashes detect endpoint changes, not transient mutate-and-restore activity. Model/effort inheritance and freshness are assignment properties, not independently attestable by Python. This bounded review does not prove runtime safety or exhaust every implementation choice. No skill or repository-wide workflow was loaded because the assignment expressly restricts inputs to the packet.

executionDisclosure.bootstrap: The initial pwd command ran before the self-recording check wrapper; its exact command, exit and streams are reproduced from the tool result in bootstrap.json. Wrapper/bootstrap and artifact-writing invocations are not separately self-instrumented; check-01 through check-10 contain the exact Python check argv, exit and complete captured stdout/stderr.
executionDisclosure.emptyStreams: Successful checks have empty stderr; these are retained as empty JSON strings. No empty evidence file is included.
executionDisclosure.truncation: Tool presentation of check-02 and the combined check-06/check-07 output was truncated. Their stored stdout/stderr are complete (truncated=false refers to stored streams). Candidate lines 61–367 were re-read in bounded check-04/check-05, and necessary current-source context was re-read in check-08/check-09. Truncation was not treated as source evidence.
executionDisclosure.stopRule: Finalized on the completed C1–C6 document judgement; no runtime validation or additional exploration loops followed.
